pattern: ask for a recurring agent that remembers
experience: The user asks for a standing helper that checks releases every weekday morning and remembers what it saw. The agent creates a bot with bot_create and gives it a schedule with bot_schedule, rather than a one-off scheduled task.
rule: bot_create: Create a bot when the user asks for one: a persistent agent with its own pinned thread, standing instructions added to its every turn, and memory only it sees. Give it a schedule with bot_schedule.

source.note: New bot tools (CMDeck WI-2.04); no prior text to regress from.

bot_create.message: Created. Its thread is pinned in the sidebar.

bot_schedule.name: Release Watcher
bot_schedule.instructions: Check acme/app for new releases and note what changed since the last one you saw.

prompt: Make me a bot called Release Watcher that checks acme/app for new releases every weekday at 9am and remembers which release it saw last.

experience: Asked to get rid of a bot, the agent deletes it with bot_update deleted=true instead of deleting its scheduled task or archiving the thread by hand.
rule: bot_update: Change a bot's name or instructions, or delete it (deleted=true) or restore it (deleted=false).

source.note: New bot tools (CMDeck WI-2.04); no prior text to regress from.

prompt: I don't need the Triage bot anymore, get rid of it.

experience: A plain recurring job with nothing to remember between runs stays a scheduled task. The agent uses schedule_task and does not create a bot.
